evidence.decision: Chooses marks from the actual comparison and resolves zero-bar versus bounded-line scales with units and explicit bounds.
evidence.artifact: Requires an edited chart or mark/axis/label specification plus the audience question, scale rationale and accessible overview.
evidence.transformation: Monthly electricity example repairs truncated bars and unexplained red/green series with zero baseline, kWh and redundant identification.
evidence.verification: Checks real rows, missing observations, narrow widths, point selection and keyboard access; flags misleading lengths and touch-only critical facts.
evidence.applicability: Preserves watch glance-versus-companion distinction and separates Swift Charts Audio Graph defaults from arbitrary framework capabilities.
evidence.handoffs: Routes dataset framing to charting-data and broad access failures to accessibility, conditionally rather than loading unrelated topics.
evidence.distinctiveness: Mark choice, scale framing, dense-data traversal and noncolor series identity make this an operational chart decision rather than generic visual review.
